title: METATRON: A Promptable Whole-Body Execution Layer for Humanoids
abstract: arXiv:2610.38027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid controllers often require task-specific training despite sharing the need for balance and whole-body coordination. We present Metatron, a promptable whole-body execution layer combining a generative base policy with a programmable skill layer. The base policy receives partial goals, collectively called a prompt, that can combine timed body-part targets, velocity commands, and style cues. It produces diverse whole-body motions consistent with these goals. Training combines motion capture, synthetic recovery trajectories, and retargeted scene-interaction motions. After training, the policy is frozen. Stateful programs called skills express task intent as prompts at each control step, drawing rough geometric sketches that the policy turns into coordinated movement. Skills are ordinary code, refined by coding agents that analyze motion data and fit compact rules without task-specific policy training. On the physical Unitree G1, on

translated_title: METATRON：面向人形机器人的可提示全身执行层
translated_abstract: 人形机器人控制器尽管都共享对平衡和全身协调的需求，但往往仍需针对特定任务进行训练。我们提出了 Metatron，一个可提示的全身执行层，它将生成式基础策略与可编程技能层相结合。基础策略接收部分目标（统称为“提示”），这些提示可以组合定时身体部位目标、速度指令和风格线索，并据此产生与目标一致的多样化全身运动。训练结合了动作捕捉数据、合成恢复轨迹以及重定向的场景交互动作。训练完成后策略被冻结。被称为“技能”的有状态程序在每个控制步骤中将任务意图表达为提示，绘制粗略的几何草图，再由策略将其转化为协调的运动。技能就是普通的代码，由编码智能体通过分析运动数据并拟合紧凑规则来进行优化，无需任何任务特定的策略训练。在真实的 Unitree G1 机器人上……
tldr: 提出了 Metatron，一个将冻结的生成式基础策略与可编程技能层相结合的可提示全身执行层，其中技能是由编码智能体优化的普通代码，无需任务特定策略训练即可在真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上实现多样化的全身运动控制。
en_tdlr: Metatron is a promptable whole-body execution layer for humanoids that combines a frozen generative base policy with a programmable skill layer, where skills are ordinary code refined by coding agents, enabling diverse whole-body control on a physical Unitree G1 without task-specific policy training.
